name: Engine-oil Supplement

features.text: Specially formulated to reduce friction and increase the lubricating power of oil.
Protects new engines during break-in and start up.
Dispersants and detergents to help prevent sludge buildup.
Can be used in all types of internal-combustion engines.

description: Scientifically formulated to increase performance by reducing friction and wear. MOC® Engine-Oil Supplement contains dispersants and detergents to help prevent sludge buildup. This reduction in friction can protect new engines during break-in and startups. It may be used in all internal combustion engines, including rotary and diesel.
application: Add entire contents to crankcase at each oil change and between changes, as needed. Treats 4 to 6 quarts of oil.
